title: Evals hook: tag eval harness outputs with route experiment variant IDs
creator: Jonas Weber
description:
Goal
- Ensure Redwood eval harness outputs can be attributed to a route experiment variant so Console can surface quality scores per {route, experiment_id, variant_id} alongside latency/cost/error metrics.

Context
- Route-level experiments add deterministic assignment at request-routing time (see ADR-047) and canonical attribution dimensions for metrics (see ADR-048).
- We already have per-request attribution fields in request context/OTel for runtime metrics. This ticket is specifically about the eval pipeline path: when we run prompt-set evals (online sampling and/or scheduled prompt-set runs), the output stream must include the same experiment identifiers so the Console “Quality” panel can compare variants.

Scope (this ticket)
1) Define a minimal, stable tagging contract between the experiment system and eval harness output.
2) Implement tag propagation + serialization in eval-harness (output JSONL/events).
3) Coordinate with analytics ingestion so the score stream can be rolled up by variant.

Out of scope
- Statistical significance / advanced experiment analysis.
- Customer-defined custom metrics.

Proposed tagging contract
- Add these fields to eval output events (per prompt-case result):
  - route_id (normalized template ID, not raw path)
  - experiment_id
  - variant_id
  - experiment_config_version (or config_hash) to support debugging + backfills
  - model_id (resolved model version actually served)
  - region
  - eval_suite_id / prompt_set_id
  - eval_run_id
  - timestamp (UTC)
  - score_name + score_value (existing)
- When no experiment applies, explicitly set experiment_id="" and variant_id="" (do not omit) to reduce ingestion ambiguity.

How tags are determined
- Source of truth is the routing decision headers / request context fields set by the router/policy engine.
- For online sampled evals: the eval sampler must read experiment_id/variant_id from the request context at sampling time and pass it through to the harness invocation.
- For scheduled prompt-set runs where we explicitly run variant A vs B: the runner should set experiment_id/variant_id in the run configuration and ensure they appear on all result events.

Acceptance criteria
- [x] Eval harness output includes experiment_id + variant_id fields on every emitted result event (empty string when not applicable).
- [x] Output includes experiment_config_version (or hash) and route_id normalization aligns with experiment attribution schema.
- [x] Ingestion pipeline can group results by {route_id, experiment_id, variant_id} without additional joins.
- [x] A basic end-to-end validation exists: create a staging experiment with 2 variants, run a small prompt-set eval, verify scores split and appear per variant in the downstream dataset used by Console.
- [x] Documentation note added for the field contract (internal: Applied ML / Telemetry).

References / links
- Confluence: applied-ml-and-evals/quality-guardrails/experiment-quality-evals-integration.json
- ADR-047 deterministic bucketing
- ADR-048 experiment metrics attribution schema
- GitHub (eval-harness): pr-812-experiment-variant-tagging-in-eval-output (implementation vehicle)

Implementation notes / decisions
- Use string IDs exactly as stored in experiment config (no re-encoding) to keep audit/debugging consistent.
- Route identifier must be the canonical route_id (template-based), not raw URL, to avoid cardinality blow-ups.
- Keep tag list minimal; do NOT attach customer_id / user_id.
- If experiment_id is present but variant_id missing, treat as a bug and emit variant_id="unknown" + increment a counter metric; do not drop attribution silently.

Testing plan
- Unit tests in eval-harness for serialization:
  - populates experiment fields when provided
  - emits empty strings when absent
  - preserves config_version
- Integration test (staging):
  - create experiment on route r_chat_completions
  - force traffic to variant via debug override (internal-only) OR run scheduled prompt-set by variant
  - verify downstream dataset has two groups with distinct variant_id and non-zero counts

Rollout plan
- Ship behind eval-harness feature flag: EVAL_OUTPUT_INCLUDE_EXPERIMENT_TAGS (default off)
- Enable in staging for 48h; validate no ingestion regressions
- Enable for beta accounts + internal eval runs
- GA: enable by default once Console consumes the new fields and backfill plan (ENG-9034) is aligned

Risks
- Data quality: missing attribution on streaming/retry paths could cause “quality” panel to show empty/biased samples.
- Cardinality/cost: ensure we do not add high-cardinality dimensions beyond the agreed schema.
- Join correctness: avoid relying on later joins with traces; emit tags directly in eval result event.
comments: 2025-02-20 (Jonas Weber): Filed ticket after eng-ml thread on quality metric definition. Need concrete tagging contract so Console can show per-variant quality without fragile joins.

2025-02-24 (Logan Wright): Please align field names with ADR-048 conventions (experiment_id, variant_id, route_id, model_id, region). Avoid raw_path. Also include config_version or hash so we can debug backfills.
2025-02-26 (Selene Huang): For regression alerts we need stable score_name + score_value and the variant tags. Please ensure empty-string semantics (not null/omitted) to keep rollups simple.

2025-03-03 (Olivia Grant): Implementing in eval-harness PR. Added optional ExperimentAttribution struct plumbed from sampler/runner -> emitter. Added serialization tests and a counter for partial attribution (experiment_id without variant_id).
2025-03-06 (Caleb Johnson): Ingestion side prefers consistent types. Please ensure experiment_config_version is a string (even if numeric) in the emitted JSON to avoid schema drift.

2025-03-10 (Olivia Grant): Staging validation run completed. Scheduled prompt-set run against variant A/B produced two distinct variant_id groups in the score stream. No increase in ingestion lag observed.
2025-03-14 (Dr. Maya Srinivasan): Approved. This unblocks Console quality panel for beta once dashboard wiring is ready. Please add a short internal doc note on field contract and failure semantics.
2025-03-18 (Olivia Grant): Merged eval-harness PR. Flag enabled in staging and internal eval runs. Coordinating with Mei Lin on dataset rollup query to include variant_id dimension.
2025-03-28 (Connor O'Brien): Marking done for console-2025.04 train. Remaining follow-up is backfill alignment (ENG-9034) and Console wiring (tracked separately).
